text.tspan: Source: UC-24 NF15–21, A1–A2; BR40, BR66, BR68–72; NS-08

Proposed function-level design derived from the SRS. Class, method, DTO and parameter names may change during implementation. Business behavior, data and branch conditions follow the cited UC / BR / NS requirements. UI messages are translated; SRS message IDs are retained.

Game rules, scoring formula, completion conditions and coin amounts remain those referenced by UC-24 / BR66 / BR68–69; no additional values are specified here. Design allocation: immediate game interaction is handled by gameEngine.ts; GameService computes the persisted final result using server-loaded content, rather than accepting a submitted score.
[the game completion condition has not been reached — UC-24 NF15–17]
